```lean
theorem lg_target {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs := by
  let τ_im : ℝ := Real.im τ
  have hτ_im_pos : 0 < τ_im := hτ
  have h_real_part : Real.re (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ) = -Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im := by
    rw [Complex.re_mul, Complex.re_I, Complex.re_smul]
    simp only [Real.re_zero, Real.re_pi, Real.re_mul, Real.re_neg, Real.re_one, Real.re_add, Real.re_sub, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm, Real.re_of_real]
    erw [Real.re_neg, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real]
    simp only [Real.re_one, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_neg, Real.re_sub, Real.re_add, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm]
    erw [Real.mul_right_inj_iff, Real.neg_eq_neg, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real]
    simp only [Real.re_one, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_neg, Real.re_sub, Real.re_add, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm]
  have h_modulus : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ = Real.exp (Real.re (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)) := by
    rw [Complex.abs_exp, Complex.re_smul, Complex.re_mul, Complex.re_I]
    simp only [Real.re_zero, Real.re_pi, Real.re_mul, Real.re_neg, Real.re_one, Real.re_add, Real.re_sub, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm, Real.re_of_real]
    erw [Real.re_neg, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real]
    simp only [Real.re_one, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_neg, Real.re_sub, Real.re_add, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm]
    erw [Real.mul_right_inj_iff, Real.neg_eq_neg, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real]
    simp only [Real.re_one, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_mul, Real.re_of_real, Real.re_neg, Real.re_sub, Real.re_add, Real.re_mul_assoc, Real.re_mul_comm]
  have h_bound : Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im) ^ n.natAbs ≥ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im * ↑n ^ 2) := by
    have h_n_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ n.natAbs := by exact Nat.zero_le n.natAbs
    have h_exp_mono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → Real.exp a ≤ Real.exp b := by
      intros a b h
      apply Real.exp_mono
      exact h
    have h_exp_neg_mono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → Real.exp (-a) ≥ Real.exp (-b) := by
      intros a b h
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg]
      exact h_exp_mono _ _ h
    have h_ineq : -Real.pi * τ_im * ↑n ^ 2 ≤ -Real.pi * τ_im := by
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm]
      apply Real.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      exact hτ_im_pos
      exact Nat.cast_nonneg n.natAbs
    exact h_exp_neg_mono _ _ h_ineq
  calc
    ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ = Real.exp (Real.re (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)) : h_modulus
    ... = Real.exp (-Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im) : h_real_part
    ... ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im * ↑n ^ 2) : by rw [Real.exp_neg]; exact Real.exp_monotone.mono h_ineq
    ... ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im) ^ n.natAbs : h_bound
```
